<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Fishbowl BI — Shared Component Mockup</title>
<!--
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  SHARED COMPONENT MOCKUP (v2 — consolidation increment)

  Purpose: review page for the fb-styles/fb-lib consolidation:
    1. PICK a KPI tile style (section 1 — replaces the left-accent bar)
    2. Confirm the TWO table tiers (section 2 — report vs dashboard)
    3. Eyeball every component being promoted into fb-styles
       (sections 3–6): .ps-btn, .topbar, .filterbar/.fchip/.fdrop
       (incl. date-range), .spill, .ms-* multi-select, .row-link,
       status .badge tones, modal/drawer/toasts.

  Palette is the SETTLED 2026-07 set (matches scripts/fb-styles.css):
    UI blue = #2d9cdb family (accent #1e7bb4 · hover #4FB0E4 ·
    pressed #176C9E). The brand core #083CF3 (PMS 2728C) is
    LOGO/PRINT ONLY and does not appear in components.
    Neutrals #101010/#506872/#8FA1A7 · navy chrome #0B3140/#0E3646 ·
    tints #DEEAF4/#CBE5FB · accent pairs purple/maroon/orange/yellow/
    sage · radius 10px cards · shadows on #101010.

  Standalone — open directly in any browser. No Fishbowl APIs.
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-->
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* ═══ TOKENS — verbatim values from scripts/fb-styles.css :root ═══ */
  :root {
    --fb-blue:         #2d9cdb;
    --fb-blue-accent:  #1e7bb4;
    --fb-blue-hover:   #4FB0E4;
    --fb-blue-pressed: #176C9E;

    --fb-success:  #1B7A46;
    --fb-warning:  #B26A14;
    --fb-negative: #C43046;
    --fb-neutral:  #506872;

    --bg-primary: #FFFFFF;
    --bg-1: #F7F7F7;
    --bg-2: #EBEEED;
    --bg-3: #E3E3E3;
    --bg-4: #C6D0D4;
    --border:        #E3E3E3;
    --border-strong: #C6D0D4;

    --menu-bg:   #0B3140;
    --menu-bg-2: #0E3646;

    --c-primary:   #101010;
    --c-secondary: #506872;
    --c-tertiary:  #8FA1A7;
    --link:        #2d9cdb;
    --link-hover:  #1e7bb4;

    --tint-blue:   #DEEAF4;
    --tint-blue-2: #CBE5FB;

    --acc-purple: #845EEB;  --acc-purple-bg: #D9CEF7;  --acc-purple-con: #3D2380;
    --acc-maroon: #802842;  --acc-maroon-bg: #F0D7DD;  --acc-maroon-con: #5E1D30;
    --acc-orange: #F69133;  --acc-orange-bg: #F5E7DD;  --acc-orange-con: #8A4E10;
    --acc-yellow: #F7C23A;  --acc-yellow-bg: #FBEDC4;  --acc-yellow-con: #7A5A08;
    --acc-sage:   #DBE8E1;  --acc-sage-con:  #1B7A46;

    --color-primary: #2d9cdb; --color-primary-dark: #1e7bb4;

    --font: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    --mono: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, 'Consolas', monospace;

    --r-btn: 6px; --r-card: 10px; --r-modal: 12px; --r-pill: 999px;

    --sh1: 0 1px 3px rgba(16,16,16,.10);
    --sh2: 0 4px 12px rgba(16,16,16,.13);
    --sh3: 0 12px 32px rgba(16,16,16,.24);
  }

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--bg-2); color: var(--c-primary); font-family: var(--font); }
  .mono { font-family: var(--mono); }

  /* ── page scaffolding for the mockup itself ── */
  .page { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 26px 28px 80px; }
  .sect { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--sh1); padding: 20px 24px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .sect h2 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0 0 3px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  .sect .note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-secondary); margin: 0 0 16px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .sect .note code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; background: var(--bg-1); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 4px; }
  .row { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .row-label { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--c-tertiary); width: 100%; margin: 6px 0 -4px; }
  .flag { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); background: var(--acc-yellow-bg); color: var(--acc-yellow-con); border: 1px solid var(--acc-yellow); vertical-align: 2px; }
  .pickbox { border: 2px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 14px 16px 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; position: relative; }
  .pickbox:hover { border-color: var(--fb-blue); }
  .pickbox .vname { position: absolute; top: -9px; left: 14px; background: #fff; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
  .pickbox .vdesc { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-tertiary); margin: 8px 0 4px; }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     COMPONENT PRIMITIVES — same class names that ship into
     fb-styles.css in the consolidation.
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  /* ── .ps-btn family ── */
  .ps-btn { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: var(--r-btn); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    background: #fff; color: var(--c-secondary); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transition: .15s; white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
  .ps-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-1); border-color: var(--fb-neutral); }
  .ps-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
  .ps-btn.primary { background: var(--fb-blue); border-color: var(--fb-blue-accent); color: #fff; }
  .ps-btn.primary:hover { background: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
  .ps-btn.icon { width: 36px; padding: 0; justify-content: center; }
  .ps-btn.sm { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 12px; }
  .ps-btn.sm svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
  .ps-btn.success { background: var(--fb-success); border-color: var(--fb-success); color: #fff; }
  .ps-btn.sm.ok { background: var(--acc-sage); border-color: #A9CDBA; color: var(--fb-success); }
  .ps-btn.sm.ro { background: var(--acc-maroon-bg); border-color: #D9A4B2; color: var(--acc-maroon-con); }
  .ps-btn.on { background: var(--tint-blue); border-color: var(--tint-blue-2); color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
  .ps-btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }

  /* ── .spill status pills ── */
  .spill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: var(--r-pill); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3;
    border: 1px solid; white-space: nowrap; }
  .spill.neutral  { background: var(--bg-2);          border-color: var(--bg-4);        color: var(--fb-neutral); }
  .spill.active   { background: var(--tint-blue);     border-color: var(--tint-blue-2); color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
  .spill.success  { background: var(--acc-sage);      border-color: #A9CDBA;            color: var(--fb-success); }
  .spill.caution  { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); border-color: #EBC49B;            color: var(--acc-orange-con); }
  .spill.critical { background: var(--acc-maroon-bg); border-color: #D9A4B2;            color: #8A1E30; }
  .spill.blocked  { background: var(--acc-purple-bg); border-color: #BBA5EE;            color: var(--acc-purple-con); }

  /* ── topbar ── */
  .topbar { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); padding: 0 20px; box-shadow: var(--sh1); }
  .topbar-row1 { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 62px; gap: 12px; }
  .title-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; }
  .title-wrap h1 { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin: 0; line-height: 1.1; white-space: nowrap; }
  .crumb { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-tertiary); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
  .subline { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); white-space: nowrap; }
  .top-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; align-items: flex-end; height: 46px; }
  .tab { height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--c-secondary);
    font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    position: relative; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; transition: .15s; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
  .tab:hover { color: var(--c-primary); }
  .tab.active { color: var(--fb-blue); border-bottom-color: var(--fb-blue); }
  .tab .cnt { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--bg-2); color: var(--c-secondary);
    border-radius: var(--r-pill); padding: 1px 7px; min-width: 20px; text-align: center; }
  .tab.active .cnt { background: var(--tint-blue); color: var(--fb-blue); }

  /* ── filter strip + fdrop ── */
  .filterbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 14px; background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); flex-wrap: wrap; min-height: 44px; box-shadow: var(--sh1); }
  .fchip { height: 26px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    background: #fff; color: var(--c-secondary); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; transition: .15s; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
  .fchip:hover { background: var(--bg-1); }
  .fchip svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; color: var(--c-tertiary); }
  .fchip.on { background: var(--tint-blue); border-color: var(--tint-blue-2); color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
  .fchip.on svg { color: var(--fb-blue); }
  .filter-sep { width: 1px; height: 18px; background: var(--border-strong); margin: 0 9px; }
  .fdrop-panel { min-width: 200px; max-width: 300px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--sh2); padding: 6px; }
  .fdrop-head { padding: 4px 8px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--c-tertiary);
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
  .fdrop-head a { color: var(--fb-negative); font-weight: 600; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; cursor: pointer; }
  .fdrop-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
  .fdrop-item:hover { background: var(--bg-1); }
  .fdrop-item.sel { background: var(--tint-blue); }
  .fdrop-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); flex-shrink: 0; }
  .fdrop-item.sel .fdrop-dot { background: var(--fb-blue); border-color: var(--fb-blue); }
  .fdrop-daterange { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 8px 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--bg-2); margin-top: 4px; }
  .fdrop-daterange input[type=date] { height: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-btn);
    font-size: 11.5px; font-family: inherit; color: var(--c-primary); padding: 0 6px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .fdrop-daterange .arrow { color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 11px; }

  /* ═══ KPI VARIANTS — section 1 candidates ═══ */
  /* Shared skeleton */
  .kv { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .kv > div { width: 226px; }

  /* V0 — CURRENT (reference): left accent bar */
  .kpi-v0 { position: relative; height: 82px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--sh1); overflow: hidden;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 10px 16px; }
  .kpi-v0 .acc { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 4px; }
  .kpi-v0 .lbl { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--c-secondary); }
  .kpi-v0 .val { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
  .kpi-v0 .sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); font-weight: 500; }

  /* V1 — ICON CHIP: tinted rounded icon square, dark value */
  .kpi-v1 { height: 82px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card);
    box-shadow: var(--sh1); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 16px; }
  .kpi-v1 .chip { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .kpi-v1 .chip svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
  .kpi-v1 .txt { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
  .kpi-v1 .lbl { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .kpi-v1 .val { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1; color: var(--c-primary);
    display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; }
  .kpi-v1 .sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-tertiary); font-weight: 500; }

  /* V2 — TINTED CARD: whole card in the tone tint */
  .kpi-v2 { height: 82px; border-radius: var(--r-card); border: 1px solid;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; padding: 10px 16px; }
  .kpi-v2 .lbl { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; }
  .kpi-v2 .val { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1; color: var(--c-primary);
    display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
  .kpi-v2 .sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); font-weight: 500; }

  /* V3 — MINIMAL + DELTA PILL: colour only in the pill */
  .kpi-v3 { height: 82px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card);
    box-shadow: var(--sh1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; }
  .kpi-v3 .lbl { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--c-secondary); }
  .kpi-v3 .val { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1; color: var(--c-primary);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .kpi-v3 .pill { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-pill); }

  /* V4 — VALUE UNDERLINE: short tone rule under the value */
  .kpi-v4 { height: 82px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card);
    box-shadow: var(--sh1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 16px; }
  .kpi-v4 .lbl { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--c-secondary); }
  .kpi-v4 .val { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1; color: var(--c-primary);
    display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
  .kpi-v4 .rule { width: 34px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; margin-top: 3px; }
  .kpi-v4 .sub { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); font-weight: 500; }

  /* ═══ TABLE TIERS ═══ */
  .tbl-wrap { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--sh1); }
  /* Dashboard tier */
  .tbl-wrap table.dash { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
  .tbl-wrap table.dash thead th { background: var(--menu-bg); color: #D5E4E8; text-align: left; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; padding: 11px 14px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .tbl-wrap table.dash tbody td { padding: 10px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); white-space: nowrap; }
  .tbl-wrap table.dash tbody tr:hover td { background: var(--bg-1); }
  /* Report tier */
  .rpt-table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 12px; }
  .rpt-table th { background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; font-weight: 500; padding: 7px 10px;
    text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; cursor: grab; user-select: none; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
  .rpt-table th:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .rpt-table th:hover { background: #164A5F; }
  .rpt-table td { padding: 4px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: middle; }
  .rpt-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #f9fafb; }
  .rpt-table tr:hover td { background: #eff6ff !important; }
  .row-link { color: var(--link); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
  .row-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; color: var(--link-hover); }

  /* ── status badges (.b* numeric tones — brand accent pairs, same colour
     language as .spill: neutral/blue/orange/sage/yellow/maroon/purple) ── */
  .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }
  .b10 { background: var(--bg-2);          color: var(--fb-neutral); }
  .b20 { background: var(--tint-blue);     color: var(--fb-blue-accent); }
  .b25 { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); color: var(--acc-orange-con); }
  .b40 { background: var(--acc-sage);      color: var(--fb-success); }
  .b60 { background: var(--acc-sage);      color: var(--fb-success); }
  .b70 { background: var(--acc-yellow-bg); color: var(--acc-yellow-con); }
  .b80 { background: var(--acc-maroon-bg); color: #8A1E30; }
  .b85 { background: var(--acc-purple-bg); color: var(--acc-purple-con); }
  .b90 { background: var(--bg-3);          color: var(--acc-maroon-con); }

  /* ── multi-select (.ms-* — tokenized, from Core_Dashboard_Template) ── */
  .ms-container { position: relative; display: inline-block; min-width: 230px; vertical-align: top; }
  .ms-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 8px; background: #fff; height: 30px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
  .ms-trigger:hover { border-color: var(--c-tertiary); }
  .ms-tag { background: var(--tint-blue); color: var(--link-hover); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px;
    font-size: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ms-tag-x { cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
  .ms-placeholder { color: var(--c-tertiary); }
  .ms-dropdown { position: absolute; z-index: 500; top: calc(100% + 2px); left: 0; right: 0; min-width: 220px;
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: var(--sh2); display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 280px; }
  .ms-dropdown.ms-static { position: static; margin-top: 4px; } /* mockup-only: show open state in flow */
  .ms-search { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-1); }
  .ms-search input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; outline: none; font-family: inherit; }
  .ms-actions { padding: 3px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-1); display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; }
  .ms-actions span { color: var(--link); cursor: pointer; }
  .ms-actions span:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .ms-list { overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; }
  .ms-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
  .ms-item:hover { background: var(--tint-blue); }
  .ms-sep { height: 1px; background: var(--bg-3); margin: 4px 0; }
  .ms-group-hdr { padding: 4px 10px 2px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-secondary); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; }

  /* ── modal / drawer / toasts (as shipped in fb-styles) ── */
  .modal-box { background: #fff; border-radius: var(--r-modal); box-shadow: var(--sh3); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); max-width: 560px; }
  .modal-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: #fff; }
  .modal-head h3 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; margin: 0; line-height: 1.2; }
  .modal-head .sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-secondary); margin: 1px 0 0; }
  .close-x { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: var(--r-btn); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--c-secondary); cursor: pointer; }
  .close-x:hover { background: var(--bg-1); }
  .fb-drawer-mock { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--sh2); overflow: hidden; }
  .fb-drawer-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 16px;
    background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; }
  .fb-drawer-head h4 { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; }
  .fb-drawer-body { padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-secondary); }
  .ds-lock-badge { background: var(--acc-orange-bg); border: 1px solid #EBC49B; color: var(--acc-orange-con);
    font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-btn); display: inline-block; }
  .toast { min-width: 280px; max-width: 340px; padding: 10px 14px; background: #fff; border-radius: var(--r-card);
    box-shadow: var(--sh2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 4px solid; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-size: 12.5px; }
  .toast.success { border-left-color: var(--fb-success); }
  .toast.error   { border-left-color: var(--fb-negative); }
  .toast.info    { border-left-color: var(--fb-blue); }
  .toast .toast-icon { font-weight: 800; }
  .toast.success .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-success); }
  .toast.error   .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-negative); }
  .toast.info    .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-blue); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="page">

  <!-- ═══ INTRO ═══ -->
  <div class="sect" style="background:linear-gradient(105deg, #BDEFFF22, #E5DEEE33 50%, #FFDEAC22); border-color:var(--border-strong);">
    <h2 style="font-size:20px;">Shared Component Mockup — fb-styles consolidation</h2>
    <p class="note" style="max-width:880px;">
      Review page for promoting the v1.2 report chrome into <code>fb-styles</code>/<code>fb-lib</code>.
      Palette is the settled 2026-07 set: UI blue <code>#2d9cdb</code> (accent <code>#1e7bb4</code>) —
      the brand core <code>#083CF3</code> is logo/print only. <b>Section 1 needs a decision</b>:
      pick the KPI tile style that replaces the current left-accent bar. Everything else is
      confirm-or-tweak.
    </p>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══ 1. KPI TILE VARIANTS ═══ -->
  <div class="sect">
    <h2>1 · KPI tile styles <span class="flag">pick one</span></h2>
    <p class="note">
      Same three metrics rendered in each candidate style — one blue/active, one warning, one negative.
      The chosen variant becomes the single shared <code>.kpi-tile</code> in fb-styles, adopted by the
      Production Scheduling dashboard (6 tiles) and the Sales Dashboard KPI widgets.
    </p>

    <div class="pickbox">
      <span class="vname" style="color:var(--c-tertiary);">V0 · Current (reference)</span>
      <div class="vdesc">4px full-height left accent bar + coloured value — the pattern being replaced.</div>
      <div class="kv">
        <div><div class="kpi-v0"><div class="acc" style="background:var(--fb-blue);"></div><div class="lbl">Open Work Orders</div><div class="val" style="color:var(--fb-blue);">42 <span class="sub">of 60 in view</span></div></div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v0"><div class="acc" style="background:var(--acc-yellow);"></div><div class="lbl">Material Shortages</div><div class="val" style="color:var(--fb-warning);">7 <span class="sub">parts short</span></div></div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v0"><div class="acc" style="background:var(--fb-negative);"></div><div class="lbl">Overdue</div><div class="val" style="color:var(--fb-negative);">3 <span class="sub">past due date</span></div></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="pickbox">
      <span class="vname">V1 · Icon chip</span>
      <div class="vdesc">40px rounded icon square in the tone tint; value in neutral dark — colour lives in the chip, not the number. The most common "real product" dashboard pattern.</div>
      <div class="kv">
        <div><div class="kpi-v1">
          <div class="chip" style="background:var(--tint-blue); color:var(--fb-blue-accent);"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 17V7m0 10a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V7a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m0 10a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2M9 7a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2m0 10V7m0 10a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2h-2a2 2 0 00-2 2"/></svg></div>
          <div class="txt"><span class="lbl">Open Work Orders</span><span class="val">42 <span class="sub">of 60 in view</span></span></div>
        </div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v1">
          <div class="chip" style="background:var(--acc-orange-bg); color:var(--acc-orange-con);"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z"/></svg></div>
          <div class="txt"><span class="lbl">Material Shortages</span><span class="val">7 <span class="sub">parts short</span></span></div>
        </div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v1">
          <div class="chip" style="background:var(--acc-maroon-bg); color:#8A1E30;"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 8v4l3 3" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div>
          <div class="txt"><span class="lbl">Overdue</span><span class="val">3 <span class="sub">past due date</span></span></div>
        </div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="pickbox">
      <span class="vname">V2 · Tinted card</span>
      <div class="vdesc">Whole card takes the tone tint with a deeper-tint border; label in the tone contrast colour, value neutral dark. Reads like the brand accent pairs.</div>
      <div class="kv">
        <div><div class="kpi-v2" style="background:var(--tint-blue); border-color:var(--tint-blue-2);"><div class="lbl" style="color:var(--fb-blue-accent);">Open Work Orders</div><div class="val">42 <span class="sub">of 60 in view</span></div></div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v2" style="background:var(--acc-orange-bg); border-color:#EBC49B;"><div class="lbl" style="color:var(--acc-orange-con);">Material Shortages</div><div class="val">7 <span class="sub">parts short</span></div></div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v2" style="background:var(--acc-maroon-bg); border-color:#D9A4B2;"><div class="lbl" style="color:#8A1E30;">Overdue</div><div class="val">3 <span class="sub">past due date</span></div></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="pickbox">
      <span class="vname">V3 · Minimal + delta pill</span>
      <div class="vdesc">Plain white card, sentence-case label, neutral value — the tone appears only in a small context pill. The most understated (Stripe-style); colour = signal only.</div>
      <div class="kv">
        <div><div class="kpi-v3"><div class="lbl">Open work orders</div><div class="val">42 <span class="pill" style="background:var(--tint-blue); color:var(--fb-blue-accent);">of 60 in view</span></div></div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v3"><div class="lbl">Material shortages</div><div class="val">7 <span class="pill" style="background:var(--acc-orange-bg); color:var(--acc-orange-con);">▲ 2 this wk</span></div></div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v3"><div class="lbl">Overdue</div><div class="val">3 <span class="pill" style="background:var(--acc-maroon-bg); color:#8A1E30;">needs action</span></div></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="pickbox">
      <span class="vname">V4 · Value underline</span>
      <div class="vdesc">Same layout as today, but the accent shrinks from a full-height bar to a 34×3px rule under the value; value goes neutral dark.</div>
      <div class="kv">
        <div><div class="kpi-v4"><div class="lbl">Open Work Orders</div><div class="val">42 <span class="sub">of 60 in view</span></div><div class="rule" style="background:var(--fb-blue);"></div></div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v4"><div class="lbl">Material Shortages</div><div class="val">7 <span class="sub">parts short</span></div><div class="rule" style="background:var(--acc-orange);"></div></div></div>
        <div><div class="kpi-v4"><div class="lbl">Overdue</div><div class="val">3 <span class="sub">past due date</span></div><div class="rule" style="background:var(--fb-negative);"></div></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══ 2. TABLE TIERS ═══ -->
  <div class="sect">
    <h2>2 · Two table tiers <span class="flag">confirm</span></h2>
    <p class="note">
      Both ship in fb-styles. <b>Report table</b> (<code>.rpt-table</code>): compact 12px, tight 4px rows,
      zebra + hover, sortable/drag headers — the summary reports keep this. <b>Dashboard table</b>
      (<code>.tbl-wrap</code>): roomier 13px, 10px rows, uppercase header — the v1.2 dashboards use this.
    </p>
    <div class="row" style="align-items:flex-start; gap:16px;">
      <div style="flex:1; min-width:360px;">
        <div class="row-label" style="margin-bottom:4px;">Report table — .rpt-table (summary reports)</div>
        <div class="tbl-wrap">
          <table class="rpt-table">
            <thead><tr><th>SO # ↕</th><th>Customer</th><th>Status</th><th>Total ↓</th><th>First Ship</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr><td><span class="row-link">SO-1042</span></td><td>Harvest Grocers</td><td><span class="badge b20">Issued</span></td><td>$8,410</td><td>14/07/2026</td></tr>
              <tr><td><span class="row-link">SO-1041</span></td><td>Pacific Wholesale Co</td><td><span class="badge b25">In Progress</span></td><td>$3,120</td><td>15/07/2026</td></tr>
              <tr><td><span class="row-link">SO-1040</span></td><td>Mercado Fresco</td><td><span class="badge b60">Fulfilled</span></td><td>$12,960</td><td>11/07/2026</td></tr>
              <tr><td><span class="row-link">SO-1039</span></td><td>Northside Foods</td><td><span class="badge b70">Closed Short</span></td><td>$1,780</td><td>10/07/2026</td></tr>
              <tr><td><span class="row-link">SO-1038</span></td><td>Bayview Catering</td><td><span class="badge b80">Voided</span></td><td>$640</td><td>09/07/2026</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="flex:1; min-width:360px;">
        <div class="row-label" style="margin-bottom:4px;">Dashboard table — .tbl-wrap (v1.2 dashboards)</div>
        <div class="tbl-wrap">
          <table class="dash">
            <thead><tr><th>Work Order</th><th>Item</th><th>Status</th><th>Scheduled</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr><td><span class="row-link">WO-5012</span></td><td>Widget Assembly A</td><td><span class="spill active">Started</span></td><td>14/07/2026</td></tr>
              <tr><td><span class="row-link">WO-5011</span></td><td>Bracket Kit</td><td><span class="spill caution">Short</span></td><td>15/07/2026</td></tr>
              <tr><td><span class="row-link">WO-5010</span></td><td>Frame Weldment</td><td><span class="spill success">Fulfilled</span></td><td>11/07/2026</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="row-label" style="margin-top:10px;">Status badge tones (.b* — numeric Fishbowl status codes, re-aligned onto the brand accent pairs)</div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:8px;">
      <span class="badge b10">Estimate / Entered</span>
      <span class="badge b20">Issued</span>
      <span class="badge b25">In Progress</span>
      <span class="badge b40">Picked</span>
      <span class="badge b60">Fulfilled</span>
      <span class="badge b70">Closed Short</span>
      <span class="badge b80">Voided</span>
      <span class="badge b85">Cancelled</span>
      <span class="badge b90">Expired</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══ 3. TOPBAR + BUTTONS + PILLS + TABS ═══ -->
  <div class="sect">
    <h2>3 · Topbar · buttons · status pills · tabs</h2>
    <p class="note">The v1.2 chrome as it ships into fb-styles — <code>.topbar</code>, <code>.ps-btn</code> (all variants), <code>.spill</code> (now incl. <code>.blocked</code>), and the underline <code>.tab</code> strip.</p>
    <div class="topbar" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
      <div class="topbar-row1">
        <div class="title-wrap">
          <span class="crumb">Manufacturing · Planning</span>
          <h1>Production Schedule</h1>
          <span class="subline">1 Jul 2026 – 30 Jun 2027</span>
        </div>
        <div class="top-actions">
          <button class="ps-btn icon" title="Refresh"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" d="M4 4v6h6M20 20v-6h-6M20 8a8 8 0 00-14.9-2M4 16a8 8 0 0014.9 2"/></svg></button>
          <button class="ps-btn">Save Layout</button>
          <button class="ps-btn primary"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="12" y1="5" x2="12" y2="19"/><line x1="5" y1="12" x2="19" y2="12"/></svg>Create MO</button>
          <button class="ps-btn icon" title="Settings"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 00.33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 11-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 00-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 00-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 11-4 0v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 009 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 00-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 11-2.83-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 00.33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 00-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 110-4h.09A1.65 1.65 0 004.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 00-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 112.83-2.83l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 001.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 001-1.51V3a2 2 0 114 0v.09a1.65 1.65 0 001 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 001.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 112.83 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 00-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 001.51 1H21a2 2 0 110 4h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 00-1.51 1z"/></svg></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tabs">
        <button class="tab active">Dashboard</button>
        <button class="tab">Work Orders <span class="cnt">60</span></button>
        <button class="tab">Timeline</button>
        <button class="tab">Materials <span class="cnt">12</span></button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <div class="row-label">Button family (.ps-btn)</div>
      <button class="ps-btn">Default</button>
      <button class="ps-btn primary">Primary</button>
      <button class="ps-btn success">Success</button>
      <button class="ps-btn on">Toggled on</button>
      <button class="ps-btn" disabled>Disabled</button>
      <button class="ps-btn sm">Small</button>
      <button class="ps-btn sm ok">Users: Can Edit</button>
      <button class="ps-btn sm ro">Users: Read Only</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row">
      <div class="row-label">Status pills (.spill)</div>
      <span class="spill neutral">Neutral</span>
      <span class="spill active">Active / Issued</span>
      <span class="spill success">Success / Fulfilled</span>
      <span class="spill caution">Caution / Short</span>
      <span class="spill critical">Critical / Late</span>
      <span class="spill blocked">Blocked / Dependency</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══ 4. FILTER STRIP + DROPDOWNS + MULTI-SELECT ═══ -->
  <div class="sect">
    <h2>4 · Filter strip · fdrop · date-range · multi-select</h2>
    <p class="note">
      <code>.filterbar</code>/<code>.fchip</code>/<code>.fdrop</code> from v1.2 plus the new
      <code>.fdrop-daterange</code> class (replaces inline styles in the date preset dropdown), and the
      tokenized <code>.ms-*</code> multi-select — the summary reports migrate onto
      <code>FBLib.Common.MultiSelect</code> which renders exactly this markup.
    </p>
    <div class="filterbar" style="margin-bottom:12px;">
      <button class="fchip on"><svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"/></svg>Current Financial Year <span style="opacity:.6;">▾</span></button>
      <span class="filter-sep"></span>
      <button class="fchip on">Category: Bakery <span style="opacity:.6;">▾</span></button>
      <button class="fchip">Location Group <span style="opacity:.6;">▾</span></button>
      <button class="fchip">Assigned User <span style="opacity:.6;">▾</span></button>
      <span class="filter-sep"></span>
      <button class="fchip" style="color:var(--fb-negative);">✕ Clear</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row" style="align-items:flex-start; gap:20px;">
      <div>
        <div class="row-label" style="margin-bottom:4px;">Single-select .fdrop panel</div>
        <div class="fdrop-panel" style="width:210px;">
          <div class="fdrop-head"><span>Customer Group</span><a>Clear</a></div>
          <div class="fdrop-item"><span class="fdrop-dot"></span>All Groups</div>
          <div class="fdrop-item sel"><span class="fdrop-dot"></span>Wholesale</div>
          <div class="fdrop-item"><span class="fdrop-dot"></span>Retail</div>
          <div class="fdrop-item"><span class="fdrop-dot"></span>Distributor</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="row-label" style="margin-bottom:4px;">Date-range .fdrop with custom inputs (.fdrop-daterange)</div>
        <div class="fdrop-panel" style="width:250px;">
          <div class="fdrop-head"><span>Date Range</span><a>Clear</a></div>
          <div class="fdrop-item"><span class="fdrop-dot"></span>This Week</div>
          <div class="fdrop-item"><span class="fdrop-dot"></span>This Month</div>
          <div class="fdrop-item"><span class="fdrop-dot"></span>Current FY</div>
          <div class="fdrop-item sel"><span class="fdrop-dot"></span>Custom…</div>
          <div class="fdrop-daterange">
            <input type="date" value="2026-07-01"><span class="arrow">→</span><input type="date" value="2026-07-31">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="row-label" style="margin-bottom:4px;">Multi-select (.ms-* / FBLib.Common.MultiSelect)</div>
        <div class="ms-container">
          <div class="ms-trigger">
            <span class="ms-tag">Harvest Grocers <span class="ms-tag-x">×</span></span>
            <span class="ms-tag">Mercado Fresco <span class="ms-tag-x">×</span></span>
            <span class="ms-tag" style="background:var(--bg-3); color:var(--c-secondary);">+3 more</span>
          </div>
          <div class="ms-dropdown ms-static">
            <div class="ms-search"><input type="text" placeholder="Search..."></div>
            <div class="ms-actions"><span>Select All</span><span>Clear All</span></div>
            <div class="ms-list">
              <div class="ms-group-hdr">Wholesale</div>
              <div class="ms-item"><input type="checkbox" checked> Harvest Grocers</div>
              <div class="ms-item"><input type="checkbox" checked> Mercado Fresco</div>
              <div class="ms-sep"></div>
              <div class="ms-group-hdr">Retail</div>
              <div class="ms-item"><input type="checkbox"> Bayview Catering</div>
              <div class="ms-item"><input type="checkbox"> Northside Foods</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══ 5. MODAL / DRAWER / TOASTS ═══ -->
  <div class="sect">
    <h2>5 · Modal · fb-drawer · toasts (already shipped — reference)</h2>
    <p class="note">Unchanged by this increment — shown so the promoted set can be judged against the existing shared chrome.</p>
    <div class="row" style="align-items:flex-start; gap:16px;">
      <div class="modal-box" style="flex:1;min-width:320px;">
        <div class="modal-head">
          <div><h3>Products in No Category</h3><div class="sub">Sales by Category > No Category</div></div>
          <button class="close-x"><svg width="13" height="13" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg></button>
        </div>
        <div style="padding:14px 16px;font-size:12px;color:var(--c-secondary);">Modal body — white slim header, 12px radius.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="fb-drawer-mock" style="flex:1;min-width:320px;">
        <div class="fb-drawer-head"><h4>⚙ Settings</h4><span style="cursor:pointer;opacity:.7;">✕</span></div>
        <div class="fb-drawer-body">
          <div class="ds-lock-badge" style="margin-bottom:10px;">Locked by admin — changes won't be saved.</div>
          <div>Drawer band = brand navy <span class="mono">#0B3140</span>.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:14px; gap:12px;">
      <div class="toast success"><span class="toast-icon">✓</span><span>Layout saved</span></div>
      <div class="toast error"><span class="toast-icon">✕</span><span>Locked by admin — changes not saved</span></div>
      <div class="toast info"><span class="toast-icon">ℹ</span><span>Master layout published</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══ 6. PALETTE REFERENCE ═══ -->
  <div class="sect">
    <h2>6 · Palette reference (settled)</h2>
    <p class="note">The 2026-07 token set as deployed in <code>scripts/fb-styles.css</code>. <code>#083CF3</code> is logo/print only.</p>
    <div class="row">
      <span class="spill active">UI blue #2d9cdb</span>
      <span class="spill active" style="background:#fff;">accent #1e7bb4 · hover #4FB0E4 · pressed #176C9E</span>
      <span class="spill neutral">navy chrome #0B3140 / #0E3646</span>
      <span class="spill success">success #1B7A46</span>
      <span class="spill caution">warning #B26A14</span>
      <span class="spill critical">negative #C43046</span>
    </div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:6px;">
      <span class="spill neutral">text #101010 / #506872 / #8FA1A7</span>
      <span class="spill neutral">surfaces #F7F7F7 / #EBEEED / #E3E3E3</span>
      <span class="spill active">tints #DEEAF4 / #CBE5FB</span>
      <span class="spill blocked">purple #845EEB</span>
      <span class="spill critical">maroon #802842</span>
      <span class="spill caution">orange #F69133</span>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
</body>
</html>
